description: LVG check of run 2: identical to radmc_co_v2.json (same n(H2) draws, views, shifts, noise seeds) but with LVG (Sobolev) level populations instead of LTE, on 5 low-density frames. Compare with the LTE run-2 images of the same frames (compare_lvg_lte.py).

notes.n_H2_sampling: one log-uniform draw per (simulation, frame), shared by its three lines of sight; mean A_V ~ 1.5-45 for the 4.6 pc box (13CO saturates above A_V ~ 5, Pineda et al. 2008)
notes.lines_mode: 3 = LVG; populations solved once per frame (calcpop, ~1.5 h serial at 256^3), images read them with lines_mode 50
notes.ortho_para_ratio: o-H2 / p-H2; 0 for cold (10 K) gas
notes.ms_max_frame: frames with Ms above this are skipped (training uses Ms <= 20; these were the slowest frames in run 1)
notes.labels_from: 3D labels are copied from the projected dataset (identical frames) instead of being recomputed
notes.observe: survey-like re-observations made from the stored noise-free cubes: beam, distance (beam size in pixels), channel width (cubes are rebinned), per-line noise. MWISP noise from DR1 (0.25 K 13CO, 0.47 K 12CO); MWISP distance is a placeholder
notes.molecule files: co.dat is the LAMDA 12CO file; 13co_lamda.dat is the LAMDA 13C16O file
notes.min_channels: "auto": max(2, round(0.2 km/s / channel width)) -> fcrao500 3, mwisp 2, nro_orion 2 (get_Observation_Data.min_channels_for)
notes.lvg_frames: one frame per forcing, Ms 3.4-7, n(H2) ~ 100, 200, 300, 600, 1000 cm^-3 (run-2 draws), where LTE is least accurate
notes.lvg_max_levels: LAMDA files trimmed to the lowest 15 levels for LVG (E_u(J=14) ~ 580 K for 12CO; only J <= 9 are populated above 1e-15 at 10 K): ~20x cheaper populations, ~3x less memory; images identical (32^3 test)
